{{Top|leg}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
'''Li-Suun Niik's Criminal Organization''' was based on the banking [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]].<ref name="aargau">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030807aargau|text=Aargau: For All Your Banking Needs|int=Aargau: For All Your Banking Needs}}}}</ref>

It was headed by the secretive [[Li-Suun Niik]]. The organization primarily dealt with electronic theft and smuggling precious metals like [[Gold/Legends|gold]], often crossing paths with the troops of the [[Bank of Aargau/Legends|Bank of Aargau]].<ref name="aargau" />

Despite his group numbering only in hundreds, Niik's organization was considered the largest, if not the only, criminal group operating in the planet. He relied on loyal followers and a wide network of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and mules to ferry contraband in and out of the planet. Occasionally, he would resort to hiring [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] when needed.<ref name="aargau" />

Even though the [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] knew Niik's secret of being [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], the reason for his success, he was largely left alone to his own devices. He managed to keep the group's operations private and away from the control of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] and [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], despite their best efforts.<ref name="aargau" />
